description: HesabYar Phase 5-5 (۵ج — Installments + BNPL): internal installment plans with state machine + multi-stage receipt + linkage guard, finance income + dunning, installment by cheque (pending_clearance), BNPL installments (Snapp Pay / DigiPay, receivable from the gateway), SMS due-date reminders (multi-provider registry), installments center UI + 11 reports.

acceptanceCriteria: installment_plan model + per-invoice installment schedule: plan linked to exactly one sales invoice, legs with due date (Jalali), principal amount (MoneyIRR digits=0), sequence; multi-stage payment terms (number of legs, interval, first due date) defined on the plan

Internal installment state machine per leg: expected → due → partially_paid → paid, plus overdue (past due date, unpaid balance > 0); transitions computed from receipts + wall-clock date, never stored ambiguously; plan-level status derived from legs

Multi-stage receipt of each leg + partial-receipt allocation rule (documented in docs/installments.md): a receipt allocates to the oldest overdue leg first, then the earliest due leg; overpayment creates an advance, never silently overpays a leg

THE LINKAGE GUARD (user key rule): every installment receipt MUST reference both the original invoice AND the accounting document (journal); a receipt without both refs is rejected with a typed 422; the guard is covered by unit + contract tests
installment_sale_contract model: late-fee rule (per contract, user-entered — never hard-coded), penalty account, early-settlement terms; contract versioned with effective date

ADR 0005 (or dated ADR 0003 amendment) ACCEPTED deciding the installment.schedule.created event: either approve the canonical event name (15-field envelope + X-HesabYar-Event-Type header contract from US-501) or decide internal-only scheduling with no canonical event — the decision is recorded, not left open

REST: POST /api/v1/installments/plans, GET list/detail, POST /api/v1/installments/plans/{id}/receipts (guard enforced), scopes installments:read + installments:write; draft by default, auto-post explicit opt-in (ADR 0003 decision 1)
Targeted tests per story + affected-area tests green; ruff + pyright clean
userStories.description: Core installment plan: per-invoice schedule, leg state machine, multi-stage receipt with allocation, the invoice↔journal linkage guard, sale contract, and the ADR decision for the schedule event.
userStories.notes: Waves (guidance; coordinator decides): A = US-540. Depends on: US-202 journal drafts, US-204 invoices, US-531 cheque legs (link target exists). Tryton already has most installment tooling (payment terms) — reuse it; HesabYar builds the per-invoice schedule + guard. Toman→Rial x10 at the boundary.
userStories.title: Installment plan core + state machine + linkage guard

acceptanceCriteria: Principal/interest split per leg from the contract terms (user-entered rate — never hard-coded); finance income recognised GRADUALLY as legs are collected (documented decision in docs/installments.md: recognition on COLLECTION, not on receipt — a bounced cheque never recognises income; the batch-1 open tension is closed by this decision)
Stepped dunning: reminder schedule per contract (day offsets user-entered); overdue legs age into dunning stages; dunning events filed to the review queue as installment_overdue (one of the 9 types)

Late fee per contract: computed from the original due date when a cheque bounces (documented decision closing the batch-1 tension: the obligation was never satisfied); fee posts to the contract penalty account as a DRAFT journal by default

Early settlement: payoff quote (remaining principal + accrued income to date, late fees waived or kept per contract flag) + settlement receipt that closes all open legs atomically; partial early payment reduces the schedule and re-amortises the remaining legs

REST: GET /api/v1/installments/plans/{id}/payoff-quote, POST /api/v1/installments/plans/{id}/early-settlement, GET /api/v1/installments/overdue (overdue report source); scopes installments:read + installments:write
Targeted tests per story + affected-area tests green; ruff + pyright clean
userStories.description: Finance income (gradual recognition on collection), stepped dunning, late fees, and early settlement with payoff quotes.
userStories.notes: Wave B. Depends on US-540 (plan + legs). The Snapp Pay 'installment price <= cash price' rule vs finance income tension is a BNPL-contract concern — it belongs to US-543, not here; internal installments always carry explicit finance income.
userStories.title: Finance income + dunning + late fee + early settlement

acceptanceCriteria: Installment payment BY CHEQUE: a leg paid by cheque enters pending_clearance (not paid) until the cheque clears; the cheque ↔ installment_leg link exists (installment_leg_id on the cheque, from US-531)

CROSS-PHASE TEST from US-531 (deferred to ۵ج — this is the test): clear → leg paid; bounce → leg unpaid + leg returns to overdue with the late-fee rule from US-541; both directions covered by live contract tests against Tryton

Cheque intake for an installment leg creates NO journal until the cheque reaches held (same rule as US-533 site intake); the pending_clearance leg shows the linked cheque (sayad_id, due date, state) in the plan detail
REST: POST /api/v1/installments/plans/{id}/receipts accepts payment_method=cheque with cheque_id; the receipt is rejected (422) if the cheque is not in a receivable state; scopes installments:write
Targeted tests per story + affected-area tests green; ruff + pyright clean
userStories.description: Installment legs paid by cheque: pending_clearance until clearing, plus the deferred US-531 two-way test.
userStories.notes: Wave B. Depends on US-540 (legs) + US-531/US-532 (cheque lifecycle + held/cleared/bounced transitions). The cheque side already exists — this story wires the leg side and proves both directions live.
userStories.title: Installment payment by cheque (pending_clearance)

acceptanceCriteria: Installment payment via BNPL (Snapp Pay / DigiPay): a leg paid through a BNPL gateway creates a receivable FROM THE GATEWAY (never from the customer), reusing the US-521 settlement engine (per-gateway/contract tranches: Snapp Pay 4 models incl. 4x25% over 4 months, DigiPay lump-sum ~14-30 days; fee % user-entered per contract, never hard-coded)

BNPL separated from internal installments in the model AND the reports: separate plan kind, separate receivable accounts, separate report filters; a BNPL plan never accrues internal finance income and never enters dunning (the gateway owns collection)

BNPL leg lifecycle: expected → gateway_confirmed → settled_per_tranche → paid; a gateway rejection/cancellation returns the leg to expected with a review-queue item; partial gateway settlement allocates per tranche

REST: POST /api/v1/installments/plans/{id}/receipts accepts payment_method=bnpl with gateway + gateway_reference; GET /api/v1/installments/plans filters by kind=internal|bnpl; scopes installments:read + installments:write
Targeted tests per story + affected-area tests green; ruff + pyright clean
userStories.description: BNPL installments: gateway receivable, tranche settlement via the US-521 engine, strict separation from internal installments.
userStories.notes: Wave B. Depends on US-540 (legs) + US-521/US-524 (settlement engine + gateway APIs). No live gateway credentials exist — gateway calls go through the existing gateway clients with simulator/manual fallback where US-524 left them; no new live connectivity is in scope.
userStories.title: BNPL installments (Snapp Pay / DigiPay)

acceptanceCriteria: SMS multi-provider registry (ADR 0003 amendment, user decision 2026-11-18): Kavenegar + sms.ir as the first built-in providers, other providers addable per installation behind one interface; provider specifics (price per SMS, rate limits, line type, contract/eNamad requirements) are USER-ENTERED editable fields — never hard-coded; only each provider's API integration shape is code

Due-date reminders: Procrastinate job (Jalali-aware scheduling, no Jalali cron — next_run computed in-app) sends reminders at contract offsets (e.g. 3 days before, on the day, 1 day overdue); each reminder logged with provider, cost, delivery status; failures go to DLQ + review queue, never silent

Simulator + manual fallback first: no live SMS provider call without credentials; a simulator provider (logs the message, returns a fake delivery id) is the default in dev/test; a dry-run mode previews the message text

REST: provider registry CRUD under /api/v1/integrations/sms/providers, POST /api/v1/installments/plans/{id}/remind (manual trigger), GET reminder log; scopes sms:manage + installments:read; Toman→Rial x10 does not apply (SMS prices are informational only)
Targeted tests per story + affected-area tests green; ruff + pyright clean
userStories.description: SMS due-date reminders on a pluggable multi-provider registry (Kavenegar + sms.ir first), with simulator-first delivery.
userStories.notes: Wave B. Depends on US-540 (schedules) + US-501 (Procrastinate). No live SMS credentials exist — the simulator is the deliverable; live provider verification is a later step needing the user's Kavenegar/sms.ir credentials.
userStories.title: SMS due-date reminders (multi-provider registry)

acceptanceCriteria: Installments center /installments (Persian RTL, VibeFarsi components): plan list (filters: kind, status, overdue, customer), plan detail (schedule table with leg states, receipts, linked cheque/BNPL references, payoff quote), plan-change flow with versioning on sale_amendment + full audit history

11 installment reports (§7.5 catalog) live at /installments/reports: overdue legs, collection forecast, finance income recognised, dunning stages, BNPL vs internal split, per-customer statement, per-plan schedule, early settlements, bounced-cheque legs, SMS reminder log, installment aging; every report states its data source + chart type from §7.5; any report whose source does not exist yet is an honest coming-soon with a reason (never fabricated figures)
Overdue-installments report (user's batch-1 requirement) is a first-class view with Jalali dates, customer + invoice links, and CSV export
Playwright: installments.spec.ts covers plan creation → receipt → leg paid, overdue list, reports page, plan change with versioning; all green against the live backend
tsc 0, eslint 0, vitest green for the new specs, build green; ruff + pyright clean
